title: Safarnama by Krishna Shukla
description: Safarnama is a heartfelt blend of storytelling, comedy, poetry, and spontaneous crowd work, where laughter and emotions flow naturally. Through personal anecdotes, relatable moments, and honest humour, Krishna Shukla creates a space where the audience does not just watch the show - they become a part of it. Known for turning everyday conversations into poetry and punchlines, Krishna`s performance moves effortlessly between fun, reflection, and warmth. Every story feels familiar, every shayari hits close to home, and every interaction adds a new layer to the experience. Safarnama is not scripted to perfection - it evolves with every audience and every room. Whether you come to laugh, reflect, or simply unwind, the show promises genuine moments, shared smiles, and memories that stay with you long after the lights go down.

title: Operation Forge X

Secure your spot and get ready to test your limits, conquer challenges, and discover your inner strength.

title: Run for Trees | Marathon
description: Organised by Sanyukt Sainik Samaj Seva Samiti, in collaboration with The Next Level Events & Production and in association with Doon University, Run For Trees Marathon 2026 is a sports and environmental awareness initiative that promotes fitness, sustainability, and a greener future.With 3K, 5K, and 10K race categories, the marathon welcomes running enthusiasts, fitness lovers, students, and community members to come together for a meaningful cause. The event encourages participants of all fitness levels to embrace an active lifestyle while spreading awareness about tree plantation, nature conservation, and climate change.Driven by the message “Greener Steps, Brighter Tomorrow,” Run For Trees aims to inspire collective action towards a healthier planet. Every stride is a step towards cleaner air, greener surroundings, and a more sustainable future.

title: Lakhwinder Wadali India Tour - Dehradun
description: Experience the timeless magic of Sufi music with Heritage of Sufism – India Tour, a soulful musical journey celebrating the rich heritage, poetry, and spiritual essence of Sufism. This extraordinary evening features the mesmerizing Lakhwinder Wadali, bringing his powerful voice and the legendary Wadali tradition to your city. From soulful Sufi melodies to powerful Punjabi folk and traditional compositions, the evening promises an immersive experience filled with devotion, emotion, and music. Heritage of Sufism is more than just a concert—it is a journey into the heart of Sufi culture, where every melody tells a story and every verse connects the soul. Come witness an unforgettable night where music meets spirituality, and tradition meets the modern soul.
